headline: Six internal diagnostic skills retired — your trigger router is cleaner.

items.prompt_template: I retired six skills that were internal diagnostics — they only fired on phrases customers never used, and they cluttered routing. A few may interest you: speech-prep is being phased out (use `memo on` with a board-update or position-paper angle instead — produces stronger talking-point output). The other five moved to a separate internal plugin. Customer-visible change: 'speech prep', 'prep me to speak', 'help me prepare for the keynote' no longer route here — use memo writing for talking points.
